$comment: State-surface registry (site-engine#229, spec hirobius/ops#576, ADR-010; ported from hirobius/hds#612). Every file or section that describes project state, and what keeps it true: generated (a generator builds it; `check` is required and names the command that fails when it is stale, statically verified to exist and handle --check; `pnpm state:check` runs the generator's), checked (a named gate compares it with the code), editorial (hand-written; owner, reviewedAt and maxAgeDays; the gate warns "review due" past maxAgeDays, and `pnpm state:review` (--strict-review, for a scheduled run) fails on it; a reviewedAt in the future is always an error). Read by scripts/check-state-surfaces.ts. Initial reviewedAt values (2026-10-12) are the registration baseline: the gate verified their paths and references, not a content re-read; owners re-read within maxAgeDays and bump reviewedAt, then run `pnpm state:generate` (docs/DOCS-INDEX.md prints this list). alwaysOn lists the files every agent loads first (CLAUDE.md, and AGENTS.md, which ralph/prompt.md reads first); the gate flags derived facts (versions, counts, issue lists, "as of" state) in them, and docs/guardrails/steering-budget.json caps their size. statusFile holds status.json to the v2 shape. registerAll makes every markdown file directly in docs/ belong to an entry (history goes to docs/archive/). ignoreReferences lists path prefixes that docs name but are not rooted here: app-relative (src/, public/), in the ops repo (ops/, lib/, docs/ai/) or deleted history (scripts/lead-gen/).
